title: "Analysis, code or files do not work"
status: "broad-beta pathway"
last-reviewed: "2026-08-28"

## Diagnose

Preserve the exact command, error, inputs, revision, environment, expected result, actual result and last working state.

## Do now

1. Reproduce the failure.
2. Build the smallest safe example.
3. Classify input, environment, configuration, logic, state, dependency, resource or output.
4. Test one controlled hypothesis.
5. Record result and next branch.
6. After repair, run cleanly from authoritative inputs and compare consequential outputs.

## Before asking

Bring reproduction steps, full error, non-sensitive inputs, environment, attempts and one precise question. Never share credentials or protected data.

## Stop or escalate

Escalate irreproducible reported results, possible data loss, security incident or governance control. Do not “fix” permissions by bypassing them.

## Evidence of unstuck

A clean run produces verified outputs and another authorised person can reproduce the route.

Use [Technical failure](../chapters/part-11/32-technical-failure-perfectionism.qmd) and the [before-analysis checklist](../checklists/before-analysis.qmd).
